# HL Privateer - LLM Quick Start
# https://hlprivateer.xyz

## Service Summary
HL Privateer is a sentiment-driven trading agent for Hyperliquid HIP-4
outcome markets. Public routes expose only the privacy-safe floor: mode,
markets, pHat, edge, and role tape.

## Base URLs
- REST API: https://api.hlprivateer.xyz

## Public routes
- GET /healthz
- GET /metrics
- GET /v1/public/markets
- GET /v1/public/floor
- GET /v1/public/floor-tape

## System shape
Raw sentiment -> StrategyAgent.propose() -> clipSize() -> 14 risk gates ->
OrderRouter.place() -> Hyperliquid. HyperliquidAccountant reads
clearinghouseState as the source of truth.

## Local demo
`AGENT_DEMO=1` is an explicit local-only mode for product walkthroughs. It
uses fixture markets, fixture sentiment, and in-memory fills; production
still requires HL wiring and a real LLM command.
